  Problem: Each of the five worker jobs (static-checks, four tests-* jobs, orchestrate-poll) repeats an identical three-step setup (Checkout repository, Setup Python, Install Python CI dependencies). Each runs `python3 -m pip install yamllint coverage pyyaml jsonschema jinja2 pytest ruff` independently. With six runners running the same install, total CI minutes for setup roughly sextuple what they were when CI ran as a single job.
  Why it fails at runtime: This is not a correctness failure; it is a CI-minute cost. Each runner pays ~10–20 s of pip setup that could be amortised via a composite action or reusable workflow that caches the install. The trade-off accepted in the plan is parallelism over setup reuse, so this is a known cost rather than a bug — flagging only so a follow-up could collapse the duplication.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
